findings.evidence: grep -rn 'incomplete|nothing executed|open quote' tests/e2e/ai-mode.spec.ts tests/browser-unit/*.spec.ts apps/playground/src/ai/*.ts → only the terminal spec (:134/:147); no test asserts the presenter failure text or the agent shell tool receiving it. Path read: apps/playground/src/ai/playground-agent-host.ts:60 awaits terminalUi.presentLine → apps/playground/src/adapters/playground-terminal-ui.ts:288-294 → presenter → mounted.executeLine; the owner callback returns runLine's number (playground-terminal-ui.ts:22-28, :296-300), so result === undefined ⇔ incomplete validator result (packages/terminal/src/terminal.ts:1424-1428, :1447). The throw-on-undefined path itself predates the unit (BASE TerminalPanel.tsx:391 threw 'Terminal did not execute a complete command'); only the text changed.
findings.summary: The agent-facing failure 'Command input is incomplete (open quote or block); nothing executed' has no carrier; honesty of the message holds by types (undefined ⇔ incomplete) and the path is pre-existing. Advisory.

ADR-0431 §1 states 'Validation that leaves incomplete input returns undefined, never invented success' but not that an owned incomplete line is discarded (packages/terminal/src/terminal.ts:1425-1427); packages/terminal/CHANGELOG.md:5 cites the ADR for the discard. Consistent (an owned line has no continuation), a dated one-line note would make the ADR state the shipped lifetime.

findings.summary: Carrier depth: a mutant that zeroes the buffer without re-rendering (echoed incomplete line stays on screen, edit state stale) passes the spec, which observes only owner calls, result and the next submitted line. Beyond the clause as declared ('nothing left for the next Enter' — satisfied); HEAD's replaceLine('') re-renders and resets state (packages/terminal/src/terminal.ts:687-694). Advisory.
Message names '(open quote or block)' but the validator also reports a trailing backslash continuation ('escaped') as incomplete; 'nothing executed' stays true in every case.
